callingStations.title: Calling numbers
callingStations.description: WhatsApp numbers the AI agent calls from, with WhatsApp Web running in a remote browser instead of a rep's laptop.

howItWorks.title: How cloud calling works
howItWorks.body: A calling number is a WhatsApp number linked to a browser profile that a call worker opens for each call. It needs a call worker running and, for GoLogin profiles, the GoLogin integration connected in <link>Settings → WhatsApp → Integrations</link>. <docs>What you need</docs>

empty.title: No calling numbers yet
empty.description: Add a WhatsApp number and its browser profile, then link it to WhatsApp Web from here.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

ips.title: IPs
ips.description: Each number goes out from its own IP. Static Indian ISP proxies; one number per IP.
ips.empty: No IPs yet. Numbers without one use the worker's own IP.

form.addDescription: After adding it, use Link WhatsApp to sign the number into WhatsApp Web.
form.editDescription: {phone} can't be changed here; delete and add it again for a different number.
form.editDescriptionNoPhone: The number can't be changed here; delete and add it again for a different number.
form.name: Name
form.orgHoursFallback: The organization's calling hours (Settings → WhatsApp → Sending rules).
form.callsPerDayInvalid: AI calls a day must be a whole number from 1 to 100, or blank to use the organization's rule.
form.callingHoursInvalid: Calling hours need at least one day and an end after the start.

proxyForm.description: A proxy a calling number's browser goes out through. It can be assigned to one number.
proxyForm.label: Label
proxyForm.portInvalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.

deleteProxy.title: Delete {label}?
deleteProxy.description: The IP is removed from this list. The proxy itself is not cancelled with your provider.

wrongAccount.title: Linked to a different WhatsApp number
wrongAccount.description: {name}'s WhatsApp Web is logged in as {linkedPhone}, not {phone}. Calls go out from the logged-in number, so this number won't call until you choose.
wrongAccount.useBody: Use {linkedPhone} — keep this login and make it this calling number's number.
wrongAccount.linkBody: Link {phone} instead — discard this login (the number keeps its browser fingerprint) and link again from the phone with {phone}. Afterwards, remove the extra device from {linkedPhone}'s WhatsApp → Linked devices.

deleteStation.title: Delete {name}?
deleteStation.description: {phone} stops being available for AI agent calls. Its recordings and call history stay. The browser profile itself is not deleted.

card.readyTitle: WhatsApp Web is kept open on {worker}, so calls start right away
card.workerNone: No worker has opened it yet
card.aiCallsOwn: {count, plural, one {# call a day} other {# calls a day}}
card.aiCallsRule: {count, plural, one {# call a day (rule)} other {# calls a day (rule)}}
card.linkedAsMismatch: WhatsApp: logged in as {phone} — not this number, so it won't call

proxyCard.unassignFirst: Unassign it from its number first

linkPanel.title: Link this number to WhatsApp Web
linkPanel.waitingForCode: Waiting for a code. If WhatsApp Web shows a QR instead, scan it.
linkPanel.waitingForWorker: Waiting for a call worker to open WhatsApp Web…
linkPanel.phoneSteps: On the phone: WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device → Link with phone number instead, then type this code.
linkPanel.openFullAria: Open WhatsApp Web's login screen full size
linkPanel.screenshotAlt: WhatsApp Web's login screen in the cloud browser
linkPanel.screenshotHint: The screenshot refreshes every few seconds. Click it to open it full size.
linkPanel.zoomedAlt: WhatsApp Web's login screen in the cloud browser, full size
